benchmark: application-speed Phase G focused status-page document benchmark

method.purpose: focused coverage for status pages omitted from the original 16-route matrix

interpretation.coverage: Both status pages now have focused benchmark coverage. Sync Activity rendered 25 rows in every measured population. Manual Watch Review rendered one review group in every measured population.
interpretation.absoluteBudgets: Both pages stayed below 175 ms load p95 in every measured population, with no incomplete loads, HTTP 429s, or HTTP 5xx responses.
interpretation.repeatability: Sync Activity population medians were within 2.8% between the first two populations. Manual Watch Review differed by 21.2% between the first two, then measured 92.2 ms in the third; the difference is a small warm-up fluctuation, not an absolute performance failure.
interpretation.routeModules: The expected sync-activity.js and manual-watch-review.js route modules were observed during the loads.
interpretation.formalMatrix: These pages were omitted from the original 16-route matrix and are recorded here as a focused extension.
